title: Country (proposed demo demand)
practical_value: Proposed field-role demand in 5 demos. Candidate reference/calendar/identifier lookup with contextual bridge and measured match rate; local transaction/person IDs support internal joins only. Country-name/code bridges; country statistics, languages, currency reference, holidays; joins need explicit representation bridges.
licence_notes: Candidate metadata is unreconciled. Per-input data/model/meaning licences remain in demand-plan.json and recordset records; Employees-derived evidence retains CC-BY-SA-3.0. No blanket CC0 or canonical new meaning licence is asserted.
reason:
Related concepts, entity keys/names/attributes and physical roles remain separately qualified in assertions. Coverage means inspected hypothesis presence, not accepted semantic equivalence or external match rate.

Phase 2 ACCEPTED: Accepted reuse of core country; this is concept/role reuse, not raw-value or cross-dataset identity equivalence. Country/territory in ISO scope is distinct from sovereignty, jurisdiction, statistical area, sales territory and locality. A place label is not a globally unique key. Country context is necessary but insufficient for same-named settlements; postcode associations can be many-to-many. Retain leading zeros and historical/category scope. Implement a versioned raw-value-to-reviewed-code bridge with ambiguity and unmatched outputs before external lookup.
